premises.name: Garage
premises.description: Where it all starts: a single garage with a bench, a rack and a draught under the door.

premises.name: Small unit
premises.description: A lock-up unit on the trading estate. A long bench for four printers, twice the shelving and a proper filament rack.

premises.name: Workshop
premises.description: A proper rented unit with a roller door you could drive through. Three long benches for a dozen printers, a wall of shelving and a rack for more filament than is sensible.

premises.name: Factory unit
premises.description: An industrial unit with a door for lorries. Six benches for two dozen printers, shelving the length of a bus, and room for a proper team.
